windows.command: if not exist go.mod copy /Y go.mod.txt go.mod >nul & if not exist go.sum copy /Y go.sum.txt go.sum >nul

osx.command: [ -f go.mod ] || cp go.mod.txt go.mod; [ -f go.sum ] || cp go.sum.txt go.sum

linux.command: [ -f go.mod ] || cp go.mod.txt go.mod; [ -f go.sum ] || cp go.sum.txt go.sum
